title: Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center to celebrate completion of Phase I of the Campus Master Plan with ribbon-cutting ceremony
summary_en: The Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center, based at the University of Kansas, invites the media to celebrate the completion of Phase I of its Campus Master Plan with a ribbon-cutting ceremony Oct. 2 at the campus near Yoder.
title_cn: Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center to celebrate completion of Phase I of the Campus Master Plan with ribbon-cutting ceremony

title: KU holds steady at No. 74 among publics in latest U.S. News & World Report rankings
summary_en: For the second consecutive year, the University of Kansas is ranked No. 74 among public universities in U.S. News & World Report’s “Best Colleges” rankings, released today.
title_cn: KU holds steady at No. 74 among publics in latest U.S. News & World Report rankings

title: KU Libraries to host KU alum, American Girl author Angela Cervantes for Hispanic Heritage Month
summary_en: Angela Cervantes, the Jayhawk behind American Girl’s 2026 Girl of the Year character, Raquel Reyes, will return to the University of Kansas on Oct. 17 for a free family event celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month.
title_cn: KU Libraries to host KU alum, American Girl author Angela Cervantes for Hispanic Heritage Month

title: KU researchers detail successes, challenges of practices to help autistic students transition out of high school
summary_en: Researchers at the Kansas University Center on Disabilities and special education colleagues are publishing a series of studies in a special journal issue detailing the successes and challenges of two evidence-based practices to help autistic students make the transition from high school.
title_cn: KU researchers detail successes, challenges of practices to help autistic students transition out of high school

title: KU Theatre & Dance season opens with ‘Songs for a New World’
summary_en: The contemporary musical by Jason Robert Brown shows off KU students’ singing talents and offers audiences variety through song, dance and scene changes.  All cast members are students and will be accompanied by professional musicians from the Lawrence and Kansas City communities.
title_cn: KU Theatre & Dance season opens with ‘Songs for a New World’
